module purpose: neorv32_imem implements an internal 32-bit memory interface. It derives a word index from bus_req_i.addr, either reads a pre-initialized constant memory when IMEM_INIT=true or updates and reads byte-wide RAM arrays when IMEM_INIT=false, and produces response data and acknowledge on bus_rsp_o.

use-case flows.value: enabled byte lanes from bus_req_i.data written into the addressed RAM word when IMEM_INIT=false
selected memory word captured in rdata from ROM or RAM and used for response data on a qualified read
acknowledge event generated for a memory access
read qualifier and acknowledge forced low while rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Selected memory word address for the current access
conceptual assets.reasoning: The access flows compute the internal word index as `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` (line 101) and then use it for ROM read `rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr));` (line 81), RAM writes (lines 116, 119, 122, 125), and RAM reads (lines 128-131). Integrity is established because corruption changes which location is written or read. The map also shows addr_ff-based selection, but those records come only from the `if alt_style_c generate` branches (lines 88-96 and 137-163); `alt_style_c := false` at line 38 makes those branches unreachable in this RTL.

conceptual assets.concept: Writable RAM contents of the internal memory
conceptual assets.reasoning: When `not IMEM_INIT` (line 107), the operate flow stores request data bytes into `mem_ram_b0`..`mem_ram_b3` under `bus_req_i.stb = '1'` and `bus_req_i.rw = '1'`, with one gate per byte enable bit (lines 114-125). The read-out flow later rebuilds `rdata` from these arrays (lines 128-131). Integrity is established because returned words depend on these stored bytes remaining correct at their addressed locations; availability is also established because these are edge-stored arrays that persist until overwritten. This concept exists only in builds with `IMEM_INIT = false`; when `IMEM_INIT = true`, the RTL reads constant `mem_rom_c` instead (lines 74-81).

The read-out flow captures the selected word in `rdata`: from constant `mem_rom_c` at line 81 when `IMEM_INIT = true`, or from `mem_ram_b0`..`mem_ram_b3` at lines 128-131 when `IMEM_INIT = false`. `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');` (line 185) then uses this value for the bus response. Integrity is established because the consumer must receive the addressed word exactly as defined by the active memory source; availability is established because the value is held in `rdata` after the clocked read. The map's combinational reads through `addr_ff` (lines 95 and 159-162) are inside the inactive `alt_style_c` branches, and line 38 fixes `alt_style_c` to false.

The module computes and stores the read qualifier with `rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw);` (line 176), resets it to `'0'` (line 173), and uses it to gate the response data at line 185. This decision is an asset because read-out integrity depends on presenting memory data only for read requests, while availability depends on a valid read request producing the qualifier.

The report flow drives `bus_rsp_o.ack` low on reset (line 174), then on each clock sets it to `bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)` when `IMEM_INIT = true` (lines 177-178) or to `bus_req_i.stb` otherwise (line 180). Integrity and availability of this event are established because external completion observation depends on these exact predicates. No reportable structural asset survives the exclusions: the event exists only on `bus_rsp_o.ack`, a field of the complete bus-response transport port `bus_rsp_o`, and transport ports are excluded whole and by field.
